# Issue templates

There are no issue forms in this folder yet.
GitHub displays an issue form only after a supported template file is added here.
A bug report should ask for the steps to reproduce the problem and the error message.
A feature request should describe the change and why it is needed.
Keep the questions relevant to this typesetting and build repository.
Issue templates do not affect the LaTeX or Python build.
To test a future form, open the repository's Issues page and start a new issue.
Do not ask contributors to post passwords, private manuscripts or client data.
There are no generated files in this folder.
